## Context

Repository-scoped delivery for the user-authorized cross-repository consolidation tracked centrally by acancelas/bos-mcp Goal #216. All substantive local worktree histories must be reconciled without deleting worktrees or unrelated changes, then delivered through the governed production path.

## Expected outcome

All substantive symphony work is present on main, released once from an immutable exact commit, and verified in the canonical production runtime.

## Scope

- symphony consolidation branch and pull request
- Complete available QA and exact-commit evidence
- Governed release, deployment, and production verification

## Out of scope

- Deleting local worktrees
- Overwriting unrelated local changes
- Unrelated product expansion

## Acceptance criteria

- All substantive local commit and worktree histories are reconciled without force-push or destructive cleanup.
- The exact candidate commit passes the repository's complete available QA and required runtime/browser verification.
- A governed pull request merges the exact reviewed commit into main.
- One immutable SemVer release is deployed through the repository's canonical provider and the exact revision passes production verification.
